A '''battle''' occurred in the [[Vorzyd system/Legends|Vorzyd system]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], in either [[3961 BBY|3961]] or [[3960 BBY]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and the [[Revanchist]]s lead the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces in a counter-offensive against the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]. Charging into Mandalorian territory from the [[Yablari system/Legends|Yablari system]] to the Vorzyd system, they were victorious there. From Vorzyd, the Republic force split up, with one part attacking attacked [[Jaga's Cluster/Legends|Jaga's Cluster]] and were soundly defeated.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle is only referenced once in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It is marked on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing the battles of the Mandalorian Wars rather than described in prose.
